title: Lap desk
text: Lap desk. So... this is your basic, blue lap desk.  It is hard plastic with a slight textured appearance. It is slippery on top... however my laptop has little rubber feet that grip the surface of the desk "ok"...still a bit slippery. If you are using it to hand write your novel... or real letters... it's the perfect surface.  It would be really great if it was a non-stick surface for laptop/tablet use...FYI... I was going to complain that the light shown was not included... however, there is a small, zippered area on the bottom of the desk.  I opened it wondering what the heck is this... Viole.. the lamp was in there.  It's pretty weak as lamps go... it does appear to possibly be LED... the bummer was the the lamp was "on" when I pulled it out... the base holds the batteries... weird little round watch size batteries and a loose spring that will fall out when you open the battery compartment.  the neck of the lamp, including the lamp head looks to be about 12".  It does fit snugly into the hole that is set for it.  The cup holder is about 1 1/2" deep... so you could technically put a glass in it... but it is very shallow... The pen holder does actually hold a standard size pen or pencil ... eyeballing the length of the pen/pencil slot to be about 7 1/2".  The bean bag bottom is comfortable... feels and sounds like it holds little mini Styrofoam beads..  I never hesitate to update my reviews if new info would be helpful... further... I do NOT receive compensation of ANY kind for my reviews.
